messages:
thomas: Quick alert - kv-cache write surge in eu1 started ~13:02 UTC causing elevated 502/503 on small set of hosted customers. Opening incident thread. Status: https://status.redwood.in/incident/3087654321

ops-bot: Alert triggered: kvcache.write_surge.eu1 (alert_id=kv-eu1-30876)

oncall-sre: Investigating. Early signals show write amplification from a background reindex job + a customer bulk-ingest. Cache eviction thundering observed on primary shards. Collecting kvstore and network metrics.

irene: Applying temporary write-rate cap on embed-write path and enabling async-write batching to smooth spikes. Command: `envoy-config apply --route /v1/embeddings/write --rate 120rps`

maria: Also scaling kv-cache-writers in eu1 by +4 nodes to increase absorb capacity. `kubectl scale deploy/kv-writer -n storage --replicas=10`

ops-bot: Metric snapshot: kvcache.eviction_rate.eu1 13:03: 14k/min -> 13:15: 800/min | embed.write.5xx.eu1 13:04: 1.9% -> 13:18: 0.06%

thomas: Short customer impact list (anonymized): K-CUST-7, K-CUST-90. Account teams pinged. Posting interim message to status page.

oncall-sre: Hotfix plan: 1) keep write-cap and batching for 30m, 2) roll restart writer pool to pick new backpressure config, 3) throttle background reindex jobs. Implementing step 2 now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-writer -n storage --max-unavailable=1`

irene: Background reindex paused at 13:22 UTC. That removed the amplification factor. Observability: eviction rate back to baseline in 10m.

maria: Confirming client errors reduced. Will monitor p95/p99 for 30m.

ops-bot: Incident metadata annotation: severity=sev2, region=eu1, product=kv-cache, impact=partial, start_ts=3087654321

thomas: Root cause hypothesis: reindex job scheduling + lack of write admission control allowed short-term write amplification to trigger eviction storm. Follow-ups: add IO-aware reindex scheduling, permanent write admission in kv-writer, and a circuit-breaker for eviction rate. Postmortem owner: irene. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.com/kvcache/eviction-throttle-runbook

oncall-sre: Current status: mitigated (write cap + paused reindex). Error rates stable <0.1% for 20m. Marking as Monitoring. If regressions, reopen or page. :white_check_mark:
